limits: Every client method, server request, notification and native item in the compiled basis appears exactly once. Grouping is an account, not an added App sender or offering.
Stable/experimental filename membership describes an exported item file, not each nested field or variant. Aggregate variants are resolved from the pinned supplier declarations and export filters.
Explicit EXPERIMENTAL descriptions are retained as experimental even where no method-gating attribute appears; this is a supplier declaration, not a claim of runtime enforcement.

Method availability is not successful execution. Runtime capability decisions remain not established unless their adopted reading supplies the relevant signal; the only new adopted availability rule is the conservative delegation rule.
New supplier methods and settings are not offered or sent merely because their definitions are imported.
